title: Roof drain flashings.
officialText:
The connection between roofs and roof drains which pass through the roof and into the interior of the
building shall be made water tight by the use of approved flashing material.
SECTION PC 1106
SIZE OF CONDUCTORS, LEADERS AND STORM DRAINS
